sourceInventory.policy: Every tracked donor file plus every public/private TypeScript declaration site; forwarding declarations map to their owning concept.

authority: Exact Wordgard commit 1acb231df7067bf5f85e694aaf4646181441e9ab materialized at ../wordgard-v0; this is the audited baseline. The latest ../wordgard delta is owned by latest-delta-manifest.json.

itemPolicy.publicItems: Every public AST declaration/export/re-export maps to the atomic concept that owns its behavior or package exposure.
itemPolicy.privateItems: Every private AST declaration/method maps by its live source line to its enclosing architecture mechanism.
itemPolicy.forwardingAndAliases: Trivial getters, re-exports, aliases, fixture helpers, and overloads map to their owning concept; they do not create concept rows.
itemPolicy.exclusions: Only files with an explicit source-evidenced non-architecture reason are excluded.
